title: Jefferson Memorial Statue, 1949 B&W Snapshot, Washington D.C.
back_text_transcription:
Jefferson Memorial
Washington D. C
June 4,5, 1949
description: A black and white snapshot taken inside the Thomas Jefferson Memorial in Washington, D.C., dated June 4-5, 1949. A female tourist stands at the base of the towering statue of Thomas Jefferson, with the iconic quotes from the Declaration of Independence carved into the marble wall in the background. Bright sunlight streams through the open colonnade on the right, creating significant lens flare and overexposure on the right side of the photograph. This image reflects post-WWII tourism and civic pride in the nation's capital during the late 1940s.
